records.jp: 空が、割れてる…………
records.en_original: The sky is...splitting apart...
records.en_auxiliary: The sky is...splitting apart...
records.en: The sky is...cracking apart...

records.jp: 止まった……のかな？
records.en_original: I think it stopped.
records.en_auxiliary: I think it stopped.
records.en: Did it stop...?

records.jp: これ、どうなってんの……？
records.en_original: What is going on...?
records.en_auxiliary: What is going on...?
records.en: What is going on...?

records.jp: いや、あたしに聞かれても……
records.en_original: Don't ask me...
records.en_auxiliary: Don't ask me...
records.en: Don't ask me...

records.jp: クラック……。やはり、発生してしまった
records.en_original: A Crack... I feared as much.
records.en_auxiliary: A Crack... I feared as much.
records.en: A Crack... I feared as much.

records.jp: だ、誰ですか……！？
records.en_original: Wh-who is that?!
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-who is that?!
records.en: Wh-who is that?!

records.jp: ユーコちゃん！
records.en_original: Yuko!
records.en_auxiliary: Yuko!
records.en: Yuuko-chan!

records.jp: 私はユーコちゃんじゃない。<CR>そんなことは、どうでもいい――
records.en_original: I am not Yuko. But that doesn't matter.
records.en_auxiliary: I am not Yuko. But that doesn't matter.
records.en: I'm not Yuuko-chan.<CR>But that doesn't matter—

records.jp: クラックってやつ……何か知ってるの？
records.en_original: Do you know anything about this Crack thing?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you know anything about this Crack thing?
records.en: Do you know anything about this Crack thing?

records.jp: てか、それだけじゃない……<CR>他にも知ってることがあるなら教えてっ！
records.en_original: Not just the Crack—if you know anything about what's going on, please tell us!
records.en_auxiliary: Not just the Crack—if you know anything about what's going on, please tell us!
records.en: And not just the Crack...<CR>If you know anything else, tell us!

records.jp: 星崎愛央
records.en_original: Ao Hoshizaki.
records.en_auxiliary: Ao Hoshizaki.
records.en: Hoshizaki Ao.

records.en_original: M-me? What is it...?
records.en_auxiliary: M-me? What is it...?
records.en: M-me? What is it...?

records.jp: あなたが何者なのか、信用できる者なのか、<CR>見極める必要がある
records.en_original: I need to know just who you are. And if you can be trusted.
records.en_auxiliary: I need to know just who you are. And if you can be trusted.
records.en: I need to determine what you are<CR>and whether you can be trusted.

records.jp: ど、どういう……？
records.en_original: Wh-what do you...?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what do you...?
records.en: Wh-what do you...?

records.jp: それまでは、教えることはできない
records.en_original: Until then, I cannot tell you anything.
records.en_auxiliary: Until then, I cannot tell you anything.
records.en: Until then, I cannot tell you anything.

records.jp: ただ一つ、言えるのは――
records.en_original: The only thing I can say is—
records.en_auxiliary: The only thing I can say is—
records.en: The only thing I can say is—

records.jp: これは、いい現象ではないということ
records.en_original: This phenomenon is not a good one.
records.en_auxiliary: This phenomenon is not a good one.
records.en: This phenomenon is not a good one.

records.jp: 全ては――星崎愛央。<CR>あなたがここに来てから始まったの
records.en_original: And it all began when you arrived, Ao Hoshizaki.
records.en_auxiliary: And it all began when you arrived, Ao Hoshizaki.
records.en: Everything began—Hoshizaki Ao.<CR>When you came here.

records.jp: あ、ちょ！
records.en_original: Hey, wait!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, wait!
records.en: Hey, wait!

records.jp: 行っちゃった……
records.en_original: She's gone...
records.en_auxiliary: She's gone...
records.en: She's gone...

records.jp: ねえ、あれどういう意味だと思う？
records.en_original: What do you think that meant?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you think that meant?
records.en: What do you think that meant?

records.jp: んー、謎
records.en_original: No clue...
records.en_auxiliary: No clue...
records.en: No clue...

records.jp: クラック？　とかいうのも結局分かんないままだし……
records.en_original: We still have no idea what a Crack is.
records.en_auxiliary: We still have no idea what a Crack is.
records.en: And we still don't know what a 'Crack' is...

records.jp: それにしても、なんで愛央ちゃんだけなんだろう
records.en_original: I wonder why she singled out Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: I wonder why she singled out Ao?
records.en: I wonder why she singled out Ao-chan?

records.jp: 信用できるのかって意味なら、<CR>新しくここに来たわたしもそうだと思うんですが……
records.en_original: If it was about trust, shouldn't she be worried about me? I'm the one who just got here.
records.en_auxiliary: If it was about trust, shouldn't she be worried about me? I'm the one who just got here.
records.en: If this is about whether I can be trusted,<CR>then the same should apply to me, since I just arrived...

records.jp: そうだよね。詩帆ちゃんも<CR>警戒されてもいいと思うんだけど……
records.en_original: That's true. You'd think she would have been wary of you too, but...
records.en_auxiliary: That's true. You'd think she would have been wary of you too, but...
records.en: That's true. Shiho-chan should be<CR>just as worthy of suspicion...

records.jp: な、何～？　恥ずかしいなぁ、も～
records.en_original: Aw, come on guys, I feel shy having you all look at me at once.
records.en_auxiliary: Aw, come on guys, I feel shy having you all look at me at once.
records.en: Wh-what? You're making me blush...

records.jp: ま、こんな調子の人だし、<CR>気にするだけ無駄な気もするけど
records.en_original: She certainly doesn't seem like someone we have to worry about.
records.en_auxiliary: She certainly doesn't seem like someone we have to worry about.
records.en: Given what she's like,<CR>it feels pointless to worry about it.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんはいい人なのです
records.en_original: Yeah, Ao is a good person!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, Ao is a good person!
records.en: Ao-chan is a good person.

records.jp: その擁護何！？
records.en_original: Is that all you guys can think of in my defense?!
records.en_auxiliary: Is that all you guys can think of in my defense?!
records.en: What kind of defense is that?!

records.jp: ふふっ。わたしも、まだ短い付き合いですが<CR>星崎さんが悪い人ではないことは分かります
records.en_original: Hehe. I've only known you for a short time, but I can tell that you're not a bad person.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. I've only known you for a short time, but I can tell that you're not a bad person.
records.en: Hehe. I haven't known you long either,<CR>but I can tell you're not a bad person, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: そーそー、あんま気にしなくていいよ。<CR>あたしたちはこれからもなんも変わらないし！
records.en_original: Yeah! We don't need to worry about it. Nothing is gonna change between us!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! We don't need to worry about it. Nothing is gonna change between us!
records.en: Exactly. Don't worry about it too much.<CR>Nothing between us is going to change!

records.jp: うん、愛央ちゃんは愛央ちゃんだよ
records.en_original: Yeah. You'll always be Ao to us.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. You'll always be Ao to us.
records.en: Yeah. Ao-chan is Ao-chan.

records.jp: みんな……
records.en_original: You guys...
records.en_auxiliary: You guys...
records.en: You guys...

records.jp: ふう、それにしても不気味な空。<CR>嫌な汗かいた
records.en_original: *Sigh* What a strange sky. And now I'm all sweaty.
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh* What a strange sky. And now I'm all sweaty.
records.en: Phew... What an eerie sky.<CR>It gave me a cold sweat.

records.jp: あ、わたしもです。シャワーってあるんですか？
records.en_original: Yes, me too. Is there a shower here?
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, me too. Is there a shower here?
records.en: Oh, me too. Do we have showers here?

records.jp: あるある！　みんなで行こ
records.en_original: Yeah! Let's all go together!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! Let's all go together!
records.en: Yeah! Let's all go together!
